claims.text: The empirical evaluation involved comparing the performance of various classification models, including Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), logistic regression, and gradient boosting, with SVM yielding the best results.
A two-tailed paired t-test with a 0.05 significance level was used to test the statistical significance of performance differences between the models.
The evaluation compared the performance of the proposed methods against a language-based baseline using Multinomial Naive Bayes, showing significant improvements in F1 score.
